methodology.directText: Responses from public APIs, retaining source, sourceId, scientificName, dataset and original URL.
methodology.derivedText: Counts and filters calculated over queried records. Population genetic parameters are not estimated.
methodology.limitsText: Coverage depends on each provider, its rate limits, taxonomy and availability. Missing records do not prove species absence.
methodology.refreshText: Queries run on demand and are cached locally for the session.
methodology.unknownText: A missing field is shown as Not available. Coordinates, markers, publications and genetic values are never filled by inference.
